description: Environment options for the product demo video engine. A profile is a starting point for the environment block of demo.config.json; adopt one, then edit it. Anything marked <placeholder> must come from your team's configuration.

local-linux.summary: Record on this machine. It must be Linux with Xvfb and ffmpeg (a laptop with a Linux VM, a Linux workstation, or a CI runner).

remote-linux.summary: Record on a Linux host over SSH while voiceover and compose stay on this machine. Use this from a Mac or Windows machine, or whenever the local machine should stay free.
requires: SSH access without a password prompt
Node, Xvfb and ffmpeg on the host
the product's dependencies installable on the host

record.shellInit: <optional shell snippet, for example selecting the Node version>
setup: <build the product, if the demo needs a build>

composeHosts.macos: Real system font and the real macOS app icons in the dock. Recommended for the most convincing result.
composeHosts.linux: Works, but the dock shows neutral tiles and the menu bar uses the available sans-serif font.

targets.electron: A desktop app built on Electron. Provide the app folder, readySelector, and optionally a fixture folder and user-data files.
targets.web: Any web app. Provide a url, optionally a startCommand that serves it, and a readySelector.

voice.elevenlabs: Narrated. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY and ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID. Cached by text, so only edited scenes spend credit.
voice.none: Silent but paced like speech (150 words a minute). Cues still work. Use it to draft the timing for free, or when narration is added elsewhere.

look.macos: Wallpaper, menu bar and dock around a rounded, shadowed window.
look.plain: Wallpaper and window only. No menu bar or dock.
